name: A Seed Offered
summary: The Rootched have noticed the Beacon. Their speaker wants to talk about how a seed ends.

offer.summary: Speaker Ilex of the Rootched is waiting on the plaza.

warm.summary: You kept the door open. The Rootched grow toward it.

cold.summary: You sent the speaker away. The moss stays.

joined.summary: You joined the Rootched. The grove behind the Beacon is open; the Lattice and the Ashfound are closed.
